title: The check loss for τ = 0.9
caption: ρ(u) = u(0.9 − 1{u < 0}): a positive residual costs 0.9u, a negative one 0.1|u|. So +2 costs 1.8 and −2 costs 0.2: under-prediction is penalised nine times as much.
alt: A V-shaped graph, steep on the right (slope 0.9) and shallow on the left (slope −0.1), with the points (2, 1.8) and (−2, 0.2).
description: For positive residuals the loss rises with slope 0.9.
For negative residuals it rises with slope 0.1 as the residual becomes more negative.
